_doc: Entries removed from the Atlas by the link-safety rule (atlas/CURATION.md#link-safety). Slugs are permanent: build.py publishes each slug as a minimal noindex stub page (no name, no outbound link, not in the sitemap) and drops the entry from every listing, count and data file. check.py fails if a removed slug is still in the data, if its stub is missing or indexable, or if any built file still links to its host. Every removal and every return is a decision under `decisions` (action remove|restore, slug, host, by = an actor id from trust-roles.json, on = YYYY-MM-DD, reason, evidence = https link; a restore also records recheck: "clean"). An entry returns once the flag clears: delete its line under `removed`, add a restore decision, restore the card from git history. check.py fails when a removed entry has no remove decision, a decision names an unknown actor, or a restored host is not clean in the latest atlas/data/link-safety.json.
